User: Hi there, I’ve noticed something odd with recurring reminders in our workspace. When I set a daily reminder for 9:00 AM on one of my personal tasks and then later edit the task title or description, the reminder time sometimes shifts to 10:00 AM on its own. It’s not blocking my work, but it’s a bit annoying to keep changing it back. Could you help me understand why this is happening and if there’s a way to keep the original time from changing? Thanks in advance.
rounds.reasoning_summary:
**Identifying potential issues**

I should consider several possible causes for the user's issue: it might be a timezone mismatch, a calendar sync problem, or issues with how reminders are parsed when edited. I could advise checking workspace settings and the personal timezone on their device, as well as updating the app. I also want to gather some info from the user about whether their edits were made in the web or mobile app, and whether they have an integrated calendar. Finally, I should invite more questions!
rounds.response: Hi — sorry you’re seeing that; I know it’s annoying to keep resetting the time. This usually happens when a timezone mismatch (including DST) or a calendar/integration re-parses the task when you edit it, or when the editor’s quick-edit feature inadvertently resets the reminder time. Please check your workspace and personal time zone settings, confirm your device time zone matches, and temporarily disable any calendar sync (Google/Outlook) to see if the behavior stops; also make sure the app is up to date. If it still happens, tell me whether you edit on web or mobile and whether a calendar is connected (screenshots or exact steps help) and I’ll escalate with that repro info.
